evidence.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity

summary: A new study introduces the ‘Densing Law,’ a theoretical framework that compresses user embeddings while preserving expressive power, enabling representation learning at billion‑scale capacities. Experiments demonstrate significant reductions in memory and compute requirements without sacrificing accuracy on large‑scale recommendation tasks.
title: Researchers Propose ‘Densing Law’ to Scale User Representation Learning to Billions of Users
